blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мы перебрались через ___ (овраг, acc. sg.) и въехали в слободу.
exercises.why: **овраг → овраг** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. овраг · оврага · оврагу · овраг · оврагом · овраге; pl. овраги · оврагов · оврагам · овраги · оврагами · оврагах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Да всё про ___ (дело, acc. pl.) ваши про хорошие.
exercises.why: **дело → дела** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural дела. Declines like DLI's окно — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. окна). Ending -о → -а.  Declension: sg. дело · дела · делу · дело · делом · деле; pl. дела · дел · делам · дела · делами · делах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Говорено про ___ (персона, acc. sg.), что у ней по носу пестрина.
exercises.why: **персона → персону** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's сестра — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у. exercises.q: Вдали сквозь ___ (утренний туман, acc. sg.) вырисовывались массивные глыбы горного хребта.
exercises.why: **туман → туман** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **утренний → утренний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with туман). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. туман · тумана · туману · туман · туманом · тумане; pl. туманы · туманов · туманам · туманы · туманами · туманах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Говорил ли он вам про ___ (своё сочинение, acc. sg.) о государственной науке?
exercises.why: **сочинение → сочинение** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → свое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with сочинение). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. сочинение · сочинения · сочинению · сочинение · сочинением · сочинении; pl. сочинения · сочинений · сочинениям · сочинения · сочинениями · сочинениях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Отряд воинов провожал Савонаролу сквозь ___ (разъярённая толпа, acc. sg.).

Declension: sg. толпа · толпы · толпе · толпу · толпой · толпе; pl. толпы · толп · толпам · толпы · толпами · толпах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сквозь ___ (пальмовый ствол, acc. pl.) виднелись арки и колонны.
exercises.why: **ствол → стволы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural стволы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  **пальмовый → пальмовые** (acc. pl., agreeing with стволы). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. ствол · ствола · стволу · ствол · стволом · стволе; pl. стволы · стволов · стволам · стволы · стволами · стволах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
